item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be showers over the region over the weekend to early next week. The anticyclone aloft is expected to cover the coast of southern China gradually midweek next week, the weather will improve and it will be hot over the region.

Date/Month: 15/06 (Wednesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, southwest force 4 later, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier at times at first.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
